description: This file declares the JSONParser class, which implements a JSON parsing utility with tokenization, string handling, and error reporting. It is part of the 'base' namespace and includes internal classes and methods for parsing JSON strings into Value objects.

classes.name: JSONParser
classes.description: Implements JSON parsing with tokenization, string decoding, and error handling.

classes.name: JSONParser::StringBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for building JSON strings efficiently during parsing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string view into a Value object.

methods.name: error_code
methods.description: Returns the last parse error code.

methods.name: GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message for the last parse error.

methods.name: error_line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the parse error occurred.

methods.name: error_column
methods.description: Returns the column number where the parse error occurred.
